NONE: A1 used to show that you agree with something or agree to do something
可以的，同意的；能接受的，可行的
A2 used to check that someone understands something or that they agree to something
（用於確認某人是否明白或同意某事）明白嗎？好嗎？
A2 informal used as a way of showing that you are going to take action or start something new
（用於表示打算行動或開始新的活動）行，好吧
› not standard used in the middle of a sentence as a way of pausing
（用於句中起停頓作用）
A2 agreed or acceptable
可以的，同意的；能接受的，可行的
A1 in a satisfactory state or of a satisfactory quality
令人滿意的；可以的；不錯的
A2 not bad but certainly not good
還可以的，還行的，湊合的
A2 in a satisfactory way
很好；還不錯；還算滿意
› to agree to something
同意，接受；批准
› permission
許可，認可；批准
› written abbreviation for the US state of Oklahoma: used in addresses
（美國）奧克拉荷馬州，奧克拉何馬州（寫地址時Oklahoma的縮寫）

example: "I'll pay you back tomorrow." "OK, no problem."
「我明天還錢給你。」「好，沒問題。」
